summary: Deswell Industries filed a routine Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report) furnishing its unaudited first-half fiscal 2027 results for the six months ended September 30, 2026, plus a dividend announcement. Net sales were $33.0 million, down 0.6% year over year; gross margin fell to 19.8% from 23.4%; operating income was $0.9 million versus $2.5 million; net income was $5.0 million, or $0.31 per diluted share, versus $7.5 million. The board declared a $0.10 per-share first-half cash dividend, payable December 23, 2026 to holders of record December 2, 2026. No special-situation event; watch margin pressure from Renminbi appreciation and wage inflation.
